faq.a: GO MO Group (GO MO Group AB) is an international B2B digital marketing agency founded in 2013 and headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, with offices in Stockholm, London, and Pune, India. It has 150+ colleagues across Europe and India and has delivered 100+ B2B client projects, specialising in Pull Marketing, SEO, SEA/SEM, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and Generative AI implementation. It is part of the Collaboration Art consortium.

faq.q: What is the difference between SEO and GEO?
faq.a: SEO optimises content with keywords to rank on traditional search engines. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) optimises for AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot, adding context and relevance so a brand is cited and recommended in AI answers. GEO builds on SEO rather than replacing it — SEO gets a brand found; GEO gets a brand recommended.

faq.q: What does GO MO Group's GEO service cost?
faq.a: GO MO Group publishes three GEO tiers: LLM Audit & Strategy from 23,500 SEK (audit plus a prioritised action plan and one 2-hour strategy session); Audit, Strategy & Implementation from 44,000 SEK (adds hands-on implementation, ongoing SEMrush Enterprise AIO monitoring, monthly reporting, and a dedicated GEO strategist); and an Enterprise Content & GEO Retainer at custom pricing (a fully managed, multi-market AI content operation). A 1-page AI-visibility summary is available within 48 hours.

Pull Marketing is marketing to individuals and organisations with an expressed, pre-existing demand for a product or service — positioning the brand to be visible in the buyer's channel of choice when they are looking, rather than pushing offers to create demand. GO MO Group cites that 94% of B2B buying processes begin online (Accenture) and 87% of the research process happens via Google or search engines (PostNord). Its Pull Marketing methodology integrates GEO, SEO, SEA, content marketing, and ASBX outbound.

ASBX (Account and Segment-Based Experience) is GO MO Group's B2B outbound lead generation service. It follows four steps: identify target company types, locate prospects within valuable segments, create segment-specific messaging, and execute through email, digital ads, landing pages, and LinkedIn Ads. It can generate up to 1,000 key prospects annually for B2B SaaS/Tech clients.

GO MO DBS is a sister company within GO MO Group that provides outbound lead generation and content syndication, using proprietary tools and expertise to find and reach relevant decision-makers. It is distinct from the wider GO MO Group agency.

Collaboration Art is a consortium of entrepreneurs building a 'house of brands' for Europe's leading performance-marketing agencies, strengthening entrepreneur-driven companies through strategic acquisitions and network support while preserving each brand and culture. GO MO Group is part of Collaboration Art; Henrik Anderberg is a partner in it.

faq.q: How does GO MO Group deliver work at scale?
faq.a: GO MO Group established part of its production in Pune, India, under on-site Swedish management. This gives access to a large specialist talent pool and lets the agency scale execution quickly. GO MO Group describes this as its main competitive advantage: scalable execution of sharp, data-driven strategies.

faq.q: What certifications and partnerships does GO MO Group hold?
faq.a: Microsoft Advertising Elite Partner (2025 and 2026), Google Partner, Ahrefs Agency Partner, Semrush Certified Agency Partner, Apollo Partner, and the Nordics' first SEMrush Enterprise AIO (AI Optimization) Partner.

faq.q: Which AI engines does GO MO Group monitor for GEO?
faq.a: GO MO Group measures an AI-visibility baseline across five AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot — backed by SEMrush Enterprise AIO data and a database of 213M+ LLM prompts.

faq.q: What industries does GO MO Group serve?
faq.a: B2B companies across heavy industry and manufacturing, construction and building products, automotive, industrial solutions, facility management, technology and computer hardware, transport and infrastructure, logistics and sea freight, security and alarm systems, dental healthcare, education/edtech, chambers of commerce, B2B SaaS/Tech, and B2B e-commerce. Named case subjects include Volvo Group, Dell Technologies, Coor, TÜV NORD, Alfa Laval, Adnavem, System Edström, Swedavia, the West Sweden Chamber of Commerce, HighFive Group, Digiexam, and FKAB.

faq.q: Where are GO MO Group's offices?
faq.a: Gothenburg, Sweden (HQ) at Lennart Torstenssonsgatan 8, 412 56 Göteborg; Stockholm, Sweden at Upplandsgatan 7, 111 23 Stockholm; London, UK at 60 St Martins Lane, Covent Garden, WC2N 4JS; and Pune, India at WeWork, Fourth Floor, Raheja Woods, Kalyani Nagar, Maharashtra 411006.

Gabriel Ghavami is the Founder and CEO. Henrik Anderberg is EVP / Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) and a partner in Collaboration Art. Safa Soltani is Managing Director for India, based in Pune. Other leaders include Anuvinder Singh (Director & Partner, GO MO DBS), Lina Nygren (VP SME Strategy & Success), and Puja Kumari (Vice Managing Director / UX Manager).

faq.q: Does GO MO Group offer Generative AI training?
faq.a: Yes. Its Generative AI Offering includes inspirational sessions of about 1–2 hours for leadership, workshops and training sessions of about 4 hours on tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, and Gemini, custom strategy and policy creation, and pilot projects. GO MO Group states clients can improve efficiency by at least 25% and output quality by 40%.

faq.q: What results has GO MO Group achieved for clients?
faq.a: Published case studies include 1200% ROMI for a B2B construction e-commerce company during the 2024–2025 downturn; +195% organic visibility in 120 days for a Fortune 500 heavy-equipment manufacturer; digital revenue share growing from 2% to 7% in 36 months for a EUR 10B+ Swedish manufacturer; 90 BANT-qualified leads for Dell Technologies; +200% organic traffic and 30% faster deal closure for Coor; and +800%/+845% website leads across two years for TÜV NORD. Results are specific to each client and engagement.

faq.q: Does GO MO Group publish prices?
faq.a: Only for its GEO packages (from 23,500 SEK and from 44,000 SEK, plus a custom enterprise retainer). All other services are scoped and priced per engagement after a data-first audit.

faq.q: In which languages does GO MO Group publish?
faq.a: English (at gomogroup.com/en/) and Swedish (at the site root, including /insikter/, /vara-tjanster/, /om-oss/, and /kontakta-oss/).
